answer_2.quote: We use the Syntactic Log-odds Ratio (SLOR) to score sentences in our tests.

answer_4.quote: Out of these, 3,420 contain acceptability ratings provided by 190 human participants, ranging from 1 (unacceptable) to 10 (acceptable).
answer_4.guideline: We use 7 as the threshold for clear acceptability, in that we only keep instances where human participants rated the acceptability of the construction in context to be greater than 7.
